AppVersion.ReleaseNotes:
• Pin important messages in a chat; staff can pin chats to the top of the list
• Clear chat
• Disappearing messages: new messages now disappear after 7 days (admins can change or turn this off)
• Admins and managers can reset a customer's password
• New app icon and easier chat menus
• More reliable online status and message ticks after locking the phone
• Other fixes and improvements
